name: Europe
description: Follow Europe, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.summary: Nature, Published online: 06 August 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02430-7 Two very different methods are used to estimate the human toll of heatwaves such as those now hitting parts of Asia and Europe.

changes.title: Opinion: Europe's summer of heat
changes.summary: Europe is in another brutal heat wave. The summer's earlier record-breaking weather already damaged crops, sparked wildfires and led to increased deaths. (Image credit: Pablo Blazquez Dominguez/Getty Images).

changes.title: Italy’s Heat Will Spread to Western Europe Ahead of Solar Eclipse
changes.summary: Red high-temperature warnings remained in effect for much of southern and western Italy through Saturday.

changes.title: Europeans face energy crisis as heat wave brings wildfires and drought
changes.summary: The Danube River hasn't been this low in over 200 years. Wildfires are scorching multiple countries in Europe. Less water means less nuclear energy generation, bringing an energy crisis. Ramy Inocencio details Europe's heat wave struggles.

changes.title: Jorge Messi, father of Argentina soccer great Lionel Messi, dies at 68
changes.summary: Jorge Messi served as his son's agent and accompanied him to Europe when he signed with Barcelona as a teenager.

changes.title: These are the "super scooper" firefighting seaplanes dousing European and U.S. wildfires
changes.summary: As wildfires rage in parts of the United States and Europe, firefighting efforts have taken to the seas and skies. CBS Saturday Morning takes a look at these remarkable "super scooper" amphibious aircraft.

changes.title: A Drying Danube River Reveals Nazi-Era Vessels, and Hazards of Heat
changes.summary: The river’s water levels have fallen as extreme heat has afflicted Europe, exposing sunken German vessels from World War II that are impeding navigation.
